assignments.name: ICP
assignments.value:
IDEAL CUSTOMER PROFILE (AI consultancy):
A good lead is a mid-sized company (roughly 20-500 staff) that shows signals it
would buy AI/automation services - e.g. manual/repetitive operations, a growing
tech or data team, recent digital-transformation or hiring signals, or an
industry ripe for automation. Score 8-10 = strong fit, 4-7 = possible,
1-3 = poor fit.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: THE ONLY PLACE the model string and ICP live. Swap GEMINI_MODEL here if the model changes. Swap ICP here to retarget the tool.

nodes.name: Read Leads
nodes.notes: Outputs a built-in row_number per row. That is the write-back matching key - no id column is added to the sheet.

nodes.name: Skip Already Enriched
nodes.notes: Re-runs do not re-score finished rows, so no quota is wasted. Blank/absent status both count as empty under loose validation.

nodes.name: Loop Per Lead
nodes.notes: Size 1 = orderly one-lead-at-a-time processing and clean interaction with the Wait node. This is NOT a quota control - the Wait node is.

nodes.name: GATE 0 — Has Company Name?
nodes.notes: GROUNDING GATE 0 (input validation). company_name is the one required field; a blank one has nothing to enrich, so it falls back before any fetch or token spend.

assignments.name: recommended_action
assignments.value: Needs manual review — no company name on row

nodes.name: Fallback: no_company_name
nodes.notes: GATE 0 outcome (input validation). LLM never called.

nodes.name: GATE 1 — Has Website?
nodes.notes: GROUNDING GATE 1. No website = nothing to ground a score on. Falls back before any token is spent.

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodes.name: Fetch Website
nodes.notes: Real browser User-Agent (default n8n UA is widely 403'd). URL is normalised to https:// if the sheet omits the scheme. Continue-On-Fail is ON: the second output is the error branch, so one dead host never halts the run.

nodes.name: Strip HTML + Cap Size
nodes.notes: HTML -> clean text, truncated to a fixed char budget. Also builds the prompt with the fetched text delimited and marked untrusted (prompt-injection defence).

nodes.name: GATE 3 — Enough Real Text?
nodes.notes: GROUNDING GATE 3 - the load-bearing hallucination-risk reduction. HTTP 200 is NOT evidence: JS-only shells, bot-walls, parked domains and cookie interstitials all return 200 with no company text. Without this gate the model gets an empty string and invents a company. HONEST CAVEAT: this is a length heuristic, not a semantic relevance check - boilerplate can still pass. Claim is 'substantially reduces hallucination risk', not 'never fabricates'. Semantic check = Phase 2.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { role: 'user', parts: [ { text: $json.prompt } ] } ], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, responseMimeType: 'application/json', responseSchema: { type: 'OBJECT', properties: { summary: { type: 'STRING' }, industry: { type: 'STRING' }, fit_score: { type: 'INTEGER' }, recommended_action: { type: 'STRING' } }, required: [ 'summary', 'industry', 'fit_score', 'recommended_action' ] } } }) }}

nodes.name: Enrich via Gemini
nodes.notes: Model comes from Config.GEMINI_MODEL - no model string is hardcoded here. Native structured output (responseMimeType + responseSchema) guarantees parseable JSON, so there is no parse-retry loop. API key comes from an n8n Header Auth credential (x-goog-api-key) - never from this file. Error output -> manual review, so a quota 429 costs one lead, not the run.

nodes.name: Shape Enriched Row
nodes.notes: Sets status=enriched and enriched_at on the SUCCESS path too (not only on fallback), and clamps fit_score to 1-10.

nodes.name: Wait — RPM Pacing
nodes.notes: Paces Gemini calls under the free-tier RPM limit. Sits on the LLM path ONLY - fallback rows consume no quota and should not be slowed. Tune to the RPM shown in your AI Studio quota page.

assignments.name: recommended_action
assignments.value: Needs manual review — no website on file

assignments.name: recommended_action
assignments.value: Needs manual review — website could not be fetched

nodes.name: Fallback: fetch_failed
nodes.notes: GATE 2 outcome (dead host, timeout, 403 bot-wall, non-2xx). LLM never called.

assignments.name: recommended_action
assignments.value: Needs manual review — page returned no usable text

nodes.name: Fallback: thin_content
nodes.notes: GATE 3 outcome - the anti-fabrication guarantee. HTTP 200 with no real text. LLM never called, so no company is invented.

assignments.name: recommended_action
assignments.value: Needs manual review — enrichment call failed (check quota)

nodes.name: Fallback: llm_call_failed
nodes.notes: Network error or quota 429 on the Gemini call. Costs one lead, not the run - rows already written stay written.

nodes.name: Write Back to Sheet
nodes.notes: Update matched on row_number - the key from the read step. Lands on the exact source row even with duplicate or blank company_name.
